svg.aria-label: The encoder. Shrink: the 1,056 by 128 log-mel spectrogram is halved in time three times, to 528, 264 and 132 steps, then projected to 132 vectors of 1,024 values. Refine: 32 blocks each update every vector three ways: attention looks at all 132 vectors, convolution mixes each vector with 4 neighbours on each side, about 0.7 seconds of audio, and feed-forward reworks each vector on its own
svg.text: SHRINK: THREE CONVOLUTIONS, EACH HALVING THE LENGTH, THEN A PROJECTION
REFINE: 32 BLOCKS, EACH UPDATES EVERY VECTOR THREE WAYS
such as the rest of its word
